name: MiniGrid
description: A suite of lightweight, partially observable grid-world environments for reinforcement learning research. MiniGrid provides procedurally generated tasks and an environment API; it is an environment suite, not a single downloadable static dataset.
citation: Chevalier-Boisvert, M., Willems, L., and Pal, S. (2018). Minimalistic Gridworld Environment for OpenAI Gym. https://github.com/Farama-Foundation/Minigrid

license.notes: The MiniGrid software is distributed under the BSD 3-Clause License (SPDX: BSD-3-Clause). Environment-generated observations and trajectories are not a packaged dataset; check upstream and any task-specific terms for the applicable usage conditions.
